start: Menu row 'Member messages' with a waiting number; the gym's server has the member-messages part; one question is waiting

user_sees: Title 'Member messages'
Line 'Members write to you from "Message your gym" on the Gym tab of their app. Your reply shows in their app, and on their phone if notifications are on.'
Chips under 'Show': 'All · 1 waiting', 'Questions · 1 waiting', 'Feedback'
Heading 'Waiting for a reply (1)'
A card with the member's name (a link to their page), a pill 'Question', 'To: Gym owner' when the member picked it, and their mobile number
Line at the foot: 'Messages are deleted 180 days after the last one in a conversation, or as soon as the member leaves the gym.'
must_not: The longest-waiting message is not first
A message of another gym is listed
An endless 'Loading…'

user_sees: Hint 'The member reads it in their app and can write back.' followed by '<n> of 1000 letters'
must_not: 'Send reply' can be pressed with only spaces typed
Letters after the 1000th are kept and sent

user_sees: The button reads 'Sending…' and both buttons are greyed
Then 'Reply sent.' in green on the card
The card now sits under 'Replied', with a line '<staff name> replied · <when>'
The waiting number in the menu goes down by one
must_not: Two reply lines after a fast double tap
'Reply sent.' shown when the save failed
The typed reply still in the box after it was sent

user_sees: The card moves under 'Done' with a green line saying who marked it done and when
The button now reads 'Mark as not done'
must_not: The conversation is deleted
The member is told it was closed

start: Today has a line about a new complaint; its link is the address /member-messages/complaint

user_sees: 'Member messages' opens with the chip 'Complaints' already picked
Only complaints are listed, each with a red pill 'Complaint'
must_not: The page opens on 'All' so the owner must hunt for the complaint
The 'Complaints' chip shows when the gym has no complaint at all

user_sees: Every type again, under 'Waiting for a reply', 'Replied' and 'Done'
must_not: A count on a chip that differs from the cards under it

start: A member sent feedback without their name (another kind of message)

steps.action: Open 'Member messages' and find the feedback
user_sees: Name shown as 'A member (name hidden)' with a green pill 'Feedback'
Line 'The member sent this without their name. You can still reply here.'
Each of the member's lines is headed 'The member · <when>'
must_not: The member's name, mobile number or a link to their page anywhere on the card

steps.action: Type a reply and tap 'Send reply'
user_sees: 'Reply sent.'; the card moves to 'Replied'
must_not: The reply reveals who the member is to the gym

start: 'Member messages' is open; one conversation is from a member who has since left the gym

steps.action: Leave 'Your reply' empty on any card
user_sees: 'Send reply' stays greyed
must_not: An empty reply is sent

steps.action: Type a reply on the card of the member who left and tap 'Send reply'
user_sees: A red message at the top of the page (not on the card)
The list is read again and that conversation is gone
The menu's waiting number is counted again
must_not: The reply looks sent
The red message vanishes with the card so nothing explains what happened

steps.action: Open a conversation that already has 50 lines
user_sees: No reply box and no 'Send reply'; a short note says why (exact words not read)
'Mark as done' is still there
must_not: A reply box that then fails on send

steps.action: Open the old address /member-messages on a gym whose server does not have this part yet
user_sees: A card saying it is not switched on (exact words not read)
No 'Member messages' row in the menu

An endless 'Loading…'

start: A conversation the owner already answered sits under 'Replied'

user_sees: It moves to 'Done' with who marked it and when
must_not: It stays counted as waiting

user_sees: It goes back to 'Replied' (or to 'Waiting for a reply' if the member wrote last)
The done line is gone
must_not: The earlier lines of the conversation are lost

steps.action: Keep the page open while the member writes again from their app
user_sees: Within about a minute the menu's waiting number goes up and the page reads the list again by itself
The card is back under 'Waiting for a reply' with the new line
must_not: A reply being typed on another card is wiped by the re-read
The page jumps to the top

steps.action: After the member has opened the reply in their app, tap 'Refresh' (exact button words not read)
user_sees: A line under the card saying the member has read it (exact words not read)
must_not: 'Read' shown before the member opened it
